newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Burwill to buy Sydney residential sites.
newsitem.headline: Burwill to buy Sydney residential sites.

text.p: Burwill Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it has signed a contract to buy two residential sites in Sydney, Australia, for an undisclosed sum.
"Construction will soon commence and is expected to be completed in late 1997 to early 1998," the investment and steel processing firm said in a statement.
The first site at Eaton Street, close to the centre of North Sydney, would be developed into a three-storey building with 18 two- and three-bedroom flats, it said.
The second site on Ben Boyd Road in Neutral Bay would be for the construction of 12 townhouses. Five of the townhouses had been pre-sold at good prices, Burwill added.

The company also said it had finalised the purchase of a four-storey office block of 32,000 square feet with ground floor shops on Belmore Drive in the business centre of Burwood. The property was leased to a government department and offered a regular and steady rental income to the company, Burwill said.
Burwill also said it had been granted an approval to develop seven townhouses in an unused petrol service station in McMahons Point in North Sydney which was bought last April.
